title: Noise-Robust Distributed Optimization Over Directed Graphs With Row Stochastic Matrices
summary: In the presence of information-sharing noise, row-stochastic distributed optimization over directed and unbalanced graphs can suffer not only from noise accumulation in gradient tracking, but also from distortion of the left eigenvector-based gradient scaling used for imbalance compensation. To address these issues, this paper proposes a noise-robust distributed optimization algorithm using only row-stochastic weights, termed Robust Xi-row (R-Xi-row).
